---
name: motion-design
description: Design purposeful UI animation, transitions, micro-interactions, and live data motion with accessibility and performance.
---
# Motion design
- Motion must communicate state, hierarchy, continuity, or feedback—not merely decorate.
- Prefer transform and opacity; use CSS for simple transitions and keyframes.
- Define consistent durations and easing; keep feedback fast and unobtrusive.
- Animate drawers, dialogs, status transitions, toasts, and list changes subtly.
- Avoid animating every incoming live comment; prevent visual noise and layout shifts.
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion and provide static alternatives.
- Avoid flashing, strobing, long blocking animations, and motion that hides controls.
- Test on low-powered devices and large feeds; document complex animation intent.
